name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my whole home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my whole home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, look for experience with projects similar to yours, particularly whole home remodels. Check their licensing, insurance, and references from past clients. A reputable contractor should provide clear communication, transparent pricing, and a detailed project plan. Review their portfolio to ensure their aesthetic and quality standards align with your expectations. Don't hesitate to ask about their team, subcontractors, and how they handle unforeseen challenges.
